During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''battle''' occurred in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] outside the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Destination: Adventure!]]''. When a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] outside of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], some [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] were right behind them. A nearby [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] patrol of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was being paid off by the crime syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]; as the smugglers were performing an errand for Black Sun [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Mal Biron]], the Imperials engaged the pirates and scared them off.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle occurs in [[Running the Sisar]], an adventure included in ''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''. It is the final stage of the adventure, and it is necessary that the players are the first smuggling ship to board the luxury liner. As such, if any other ships arrive before them, the [[Wikipedia:Gamemaster|gamemaster]] is encouraged to establish that the pirates inflict damage on those ships, slowing them down and allowing the player characters to overtake them.
